plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Spec-driven Claude Code plugin. Audit a repo for the work worth doing, grill business + technical goals as distinct passes, plan into a dependency-ordered task graph, build hands-off. Product memory is four docs loaded by role: .claude/product.md (North Star + Language), roadmap.md, architecture.md, lessons.md; durable lessons live in Claude Code's auto-memory; the laziest-working-diff build discipline is owned in-plugin.
